value.rationale: The hexagon is the smallest planar centrally symmetric polygonal class beyond parallelograms. An exact value and optimizer provide a reusable benchmark for the recently developed containment-based chirality invariant and quantify the strict gap below the universal sqrt(2) bound for this natural non-reflection-symmetric zonotope.
